§7Name an Armor Stand to equip a ZlCosmetics outfit
setting.zlcosmetics.showAccessories.true: §7You'll see accessories in-game, and other players will see any accessories you have equipped.
setting.zlcosmetics.showAccessories.fals: §7You won't see accessories in-game, and other players won't see any accessories you have equipped.
setting.zlcosmetics.showIcons.true.descr: §7Your nametag icon will be visible in-game, and you'll see other players' icons too.
setting.zlcosmetics.showIcons.false.desc: §7You won't see nametag icons in-game, but other players will still see yours.
setting.zlcosmetics.showLore.true.descri: §7Your lore will be visible in-game, and you'll see other players' lore too.
setting.zlcosmetics.showLore.false.descr: §7Your lore will be hidden in-game, and you won't see other players' lore either.
setting.zlcosmetics.showOfflineIcons.tru: §7The nametag icons of any offline players will be visible in-game, but slightly faded.
setting.zlcosmetics.showOfflineIcons.fal: §7You won't see any offline nametag icons in-game, but yours will still be visible for others.
setting.zlcosmetics.showOnlineActivity.t: §7Your nametag icon will show whether you are online or offline.
setting.zlcosmetics.showOnlineActivity.f: §7Your nametag icon will always show as online, regardless of your actual status.
§7You will see your own nametag in third-person (F5) view.
setting.zlcosmetics.showOwnNametag.false: §7Your nametag will be hidden in third-person (F5) view.
setting.zlcosmetics.showSpecialIcons.tru: §7All special icons will be visible in-game.
setting.zlcosmetics.showSpecialIcons.fal: §7All special nametag icons in-game will be replaced with the default one.
setting.zlcosmetics.useCloudSettings.tru: §7Your cloud settings will be used instead of the settings curated by the modpack author.
setting.zlcosmetics.useCloudSettings.fal: §7Your current zlcosmetics settings are curated by the modpack author.
setting.zlcosmetics.useModpackIcons.true: §7Icons set by modpacks will be used instead of regular icons when available.
setting.zlcosmetics.useModpackIcons.fals: §7You'll always see regular icons instead of modpack icons in-game.
